name: Founder decision: Ratify the founders' review form, the absorber above the founders, and the house's continuity part of a founder's departure; and read and report the operating agreement's departure, incapacity, deadlock, and removal provisions
text_content:
P33, P34, P36 to P38. The founders have no review and none is built under another name: a founder's domain is read on dimension 1 by the domain read against the rows and the goal pages, the building's supply on dimension 4 by the load line, conduct on dimension 3 by the flag and by a range breach written as a question on the partners' page, and self-directed mastery not at all, with no interval, block, state, rating, or pay reach; whether the domain read uses this three-dimension form or the rows and goal pages alone is the founders' to ratify. There is no absorber above the founders by design: a founder's failure is absorbed by Principle 4 run on the founders' own mechanisms at the partners' review with an evidence line written by the other partner naming no person, by the record through the version and the read-back, and by the reserved classes held at the status quo, never by a lead, the team, the public, or a person above. A founder's departure is a Class A event under the operating agreement's process, and the house's part is continuity: the three-pass read on the founding seat, the memory-failure pass on prompt B's register, a structure change entry with the departure's line as reason, the seat's ledger rows moved to the other partner as a node-overload line with a closing condition, the founder hand-over block, and coverage only. The founders read the operating agreement and report what it holds; the program never reads it. Extends 86akh3t62, 17tn048qg2h, 17tn048qfp3, and 17tn048qepd by reference. High.
